statement.zh: Yon 综合依据长期发掘将拉斯沙姆拉表述为含宫殿、卫城神庙与港口联系的晚青铜都城（Yon 2006）。
statement.en: Yon’s synthesis, based on long-term excavation, frames Ras Shamra as an LBA capital with palace, acropolis temples, and port links (Yon 2006).
